posts.meta_description:
48K likes, 646 comments - sonamkapoor on August 19, 2026: "Coming out of my postpartum sabbatical for dearest Yash at @birdhichand — wearing his extraordinary jewels and celebrating a relationship between our families that goes back two generations. 🤍

Congratulations on the beautiful new store, Yash. It was such a joy to be there for this special moment, and even more wonderful to see your father.

Wearing a hand-embroidered ensemble by @shantibanaras and @raw_mango, crafted on a tussar georgette base and drawing from the traditional vocabulary of Pichwai painting. The motifs are rendered entirely by hand in fine resham threads, with kasab tracing and highlighting the intricate details.

And the perfect backdrop: these beautiful doors designed by the immensely talented @agamdesignstudio and BhanuPrasadMelon, @bhanus.in featuring the most exquisite marquetry.

Look: @shantibanaras & @raw_mango
Jewels & clutch: @birdhichand
Styled by: @rheakapoor & @manishamelwani
Style team: @stylebyvanshika @samyaguptaaaa
Make-up: @divyashetty_
Hair: @komalvora_
Photographer: @saranggupta
Draper: @shabnamshaikh639".
